title: 5 Live-Action Anime That Put Dragon Ball: Evolution to Shame
content: Live-action adaptations of anime and manga have always been controversial, and there’s a major reason why. These adaptations, whether they’re fantasies or even slice-of-life about daily lives, tend to change everything from the original manga, which doesn’t sit well with many fans.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End
content: There’s no denying that Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is the biggest fantasy anime of the decade. The anime premiered in 2023, and since then, its popularity only keeps rising. The anime is all set to return with Season 3 next year to adapt the best arc in the manga so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Also Streams on Hulu in U.S. on October 11
content: The series will begin airing on the Fuji TV channel and its affiliates on October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST (10:15 a.m. EDT), taking over the timeslot of the One Piece anime, which aired its last episode for this year on September 27.
author: ANN

title: Blazblue: CentralFiction Fighting Game Gets Release on PS5
content: Arc System Works Europe revealed on Saturday that its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game will get a release on the PlayStation 5. The PS5 version will include rollback netcode, cross-play with PC, four new text languages (French, Italian, German, and Spanish), and new features in Training Mode.
author: ANN

title: Japanese Studio Creative Freaks to Lead Production on Sentinel 6 Anime Executive Produced by NBA, NFL Players Michael Carter-Williams, Jamaal Williams
content: The Hollywood Reporter entertainment news website reported on Saturday that former NBA player Michael Carter-Williams and NFL player Jamaal Williams will executive produce Sentinel 6 , an "Afro-futurist sci-fi adventure anime." title: New 'Naruto' Manga 'Shadow Rising' Announced
content: The Naruto: What's Next? panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new Naruto manga titled Naruto: Shadow Rising , revealing a super teaser announcement video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Naruto x Ninkuu' Crossover Anime Announced
content: The "Naruto: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a brand new four-episode crossover anime based on Masashi Kishimoto 's Naruto manga and Kouji Kiriyama 's Ninkuu manga on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Anime's 2nd Part Reveals January 2027 Debut in Video
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed in a new trailer on Sunday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the third anime season based on ONE and Yūsuke Murata 's One Punch Man manga will debut in January 2027. Viz Media is streaming an English-subtitled version of the trailer.
author: ANN

title: Naruto Mobile Game to Get Worldwide Release; Naruto Card Game Reveals Demo, Release Dates
content: The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that the Naruto Mobile game, currently only available in Mainland China, will get a worldwide release. More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.
